providers.name: OpenAI API
providers.pricingBasis: Per-model input, output, cached-input, and batch-job token rates; reasoning tokens billed as output.

providers.name: Anthropic API
providers.pricingBasis: Model-specific input, output, prompt-cache write (5m TTL), and prompt-cache read (90% discount) token rates.

providers.name: Google Gemini API
providers.pricingBasis: Prompt length tier (<=128k vs >128k), context caching hourly/read rates, and multimodal input dimensions.

providers.name: Amazon Bedrock
providers.pricingBasis: On-demand invocation token rates, prompt caching, and hourly Provisioned Throughput commitment reservations.

providers.name: Google Cloud Model Garden & Vertex AI
providers.pricingBasis: Enterprise regional serving rates, custom endpoints, and throughput-based quota reservations.

providers.name: Azure OpenAI Service
providers.pricingBasis: Standard pay-as-you-go consumption tokens and Provisioned Throughput Units (PTU) reserved capacity.

providers.name: Self-Hosted vLLM Inference
providers.pricingBasis: Fixed GPU cluster compute-hours, memory utilization, standby idle costs, and engineering overhead.
